verdict.rationale: Luma ships Luma Agents for multi-step creative workflows, so letting users plug in external MCP servers is a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence documents MCP client support or any way to connect third-party tool servers. The agents, Skills and API evidence describes Luma's own generation capabilities, not consuming external tools.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
